title: Activate your event access
explanation: This code can be used once on a device of your choice. Activating access signs you in on that device. Opening this page does not use the code.
qr-explanation: Have the participant scan this code on the device they will use at the event.
qr-expired: This code has expired. Ask an organizer for a new one.
unavailable: Access is temporarily unavailable. Please ask an organizer for a new code.
